notes: A215010_closes: equiangular 10-gon with sides t+m_k d, m=(0,6,2,8,4,5,1,7,3,9) a permutation of 0..9, closes (sum (t+m_k d) w^k = 0 for primitive 10th root w), so hexagons are not the only ones. Outside Lean: closed equiangular polygon with positive sides is simple and convex (standard).

sources.cite: M. Bras-Amoros, M. Pujol, Side lengths of equiangular polygons, Amer. Math. Monthly 122 (2015) 476-478
sources.what: integer side tuples of equiangular polygons
